name: spora-ai/spora-plugin-usage-frontend
description: Pre-built Vue SPA for the Spora Usage app — usage metering, credits and limits. Delivered as type `spora-plugin-frontend`; the host SPA lazy-loads it via /plugins/usage/main.js (the parent plugin's `plugin.json#slug`, not this package's name).

extra._comment: Must equal plugin.json#slug in spora-plugin-usage; SporaPluginFrontendInstaller refuses to install when missing.
